title: 28,000 Days: Your Life in Four Parts

scenes.voice: Your salary has to pay for twice as many days as you'll ever work.
scenes.text: Your salary pays for 2x your working days
scenes.visual: A formal document resting on a wooden desk with a calendar flipping rapidly in the soft-focus background.

scenes.voice: You'll live about 28,000 days. But you'll only get paid for half of them.
scenes.visual: A massive mechanical odometer with blurred spinning digits in a dimly lit minimalist studio.

scenes.voice: Let's split a life into four parts.
scenes.visual: A long glowing timeline divided evenly into four distinct rectangular blocks.

scenes.voice: Zero to twenty: you're growing up and studying. No income.
scenes.visual: The first block of a timeline illuminated brightly with colorful toy blocks and a small school bag nearby.

scenes.voice: Twenty to forty: you start earning. First job, first car, maybe a first home and a family.
scenes.visual: The second block of a timeline glowing with miniature icons representing a briefcase, car, and house.

scenes.voice: Forty to sixty: you earn more, upgrade more, and your kids grow up.
scenes.visual: The third block of a timeline illuminated with a rising bar chart and a graduation cap icon.

scenes.voice: Sixty to eighty: most of us stop working and live on what we saved.
scenes.visual: The final block of a timeline glowing softly with a ceramic piggy bank resting on a wooden surface.

scenes.voice: So about 14,000 working days have to pay for all 28,000. For you, and for your family.
scenes.visual: A complete four-part timeline where only the two middle sections glow with a warm golden light.
A minimalist dark background with subtle moody lighting and a dramatic dip in ambient brightness.

scenes.voice: One: if you get sick, will your hard-earned money go to hospital bills instead of your future?
scenes.visual: A medical symbol glowing softly beside a leather wallet with loose metallic coins spilling out.

scenes.voice: Two: if you can't work, does your income stop too?
scenes.visual: A digital financial graph showing a sudden steep drop in the green income line to zero.

scenes.voice: Three: will your kids get the education you want for them?
scenes.visual: A graduation cap resting neatly on top of a glowing glass jar filled with small coins.

scenes.voice: Four: will you retire comfortably, or just retire?
scenes.visual: A split-screen composition contrasting a full ceramic piggy bank with a nearly empty one.

scenes.voice: Most people can't tick all four. That's normal. Knowing which one you can't answer is the first step.
scenes.visual: A clean digital checklist interface with some items checked and others left completely empty.

scenes.text: For general education only. Not financial advice.
scenes.visual: A minimal, elegant end card with soft neutral lighting and no text or graphics.

caption:
Your salary has to cover twice as many days as you'll ever work.
Understanding the four phases of life helps you plan ahead.
